يستأهلون (form X)
# يَسْتَأْهِلُونَ (yastaʔhilūna) /jas.taʔ.hi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# يُسْتَأْهَلُونَ (yustaʔhalūna) /jus.taʔ.ha.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
